units.source_text: 我絕非瞧不起他家的貧寒（那時我並不覺得難吃，而且很感激老母親的心意。

en.t: I was by no means looking down on his family's poverty; at the time I did not find it unpleasant, and I was deeply grateful for his old mother's kindness.

units.source_text: 儘管我恐懼貧窮，但毫無輕蔑之心）。

en.t: Although I feared poverty, I had no contempt for it at all.

units.source_text: 年糕紅豆湯和吃著年糕紅豆湯喜形於色的堀木，讓我窺見都市人樸素的本性，

en.t: The red bean soup with rice cakes, and Horiki's face brightening as he ate it, let me glimpse the simple nature of city people,

units.source_text: 以及家人與外人有明顯區別的東京人家庭的真實一面。

en.t: and also the real face of Tokyo households, where family and outsiders are sharply distinguished.

units.source_text: 唯有我這個蠢貨不分內外，接二連三地逃避人類的生活，

en.t: Only I, the fool who made no distinction between inside and outside, went on fleeing from human life again and again,

units.source_text: 甚至還被堀木這種人嫌棄。

en.t: and was even despised by someone like Horiki.

units.source_text: 我感到極其狼狽，手握漆面斑駁的筷子，

en.t: I felt utterly flustered, holding chopsticks whose lacquer had peeled away,

units.source_text: 只想提筆記錄下難以忍受的淒涼感受。

en.t: and all I wanted was to take up my pen and record the unbearable loneliness I felt.

units.source_text: 「不好意思，抱歉，我今天要去辦點事。」

en.t: Sorry, forgive me, but I have something to take care of today.
